_about: Drawn 3D board for site/boardviz (docs/how-to-contribute.md, Add a board drawing). Millimeters from the board's bottom-left corner on the component side (the back of the module), x right, y up. The glass hangs under the board (side bottom). The module has no 40-pin header: it has a 15-way connector (Interface 2) at 1.25 mm pitch, drawn with the fpc part at its real pitch; its pins are the wire ends and tap targets. Positions measured from the lab's photo of the back of the module and Waveshare's dimension drawing.
source: Outline, glass and hole sizes from Waveshare's dimension drawing (3.5inch-Capacitive-Touch-LCD-details-size.jpg, wiki: 3.5inch Capacitive Touch LCD); part positions and colors from the lab's photo of the module's back (site/media/parts/waveshare-35-touch.jpg); pin names from the silkscreen and the wiki's 15-pin table.

parts.label: Screen
parts.title: 3.5 inch glass and touch panel
parts.text: The 320 x 480 color screen with a finger-touch layer on top, in a black glass face 92 x 61 mm. It sits on the far side of this board, so it shows from underneath. The picture area is 73.4 x 49.0 mm.

parts.label: Interface 2
parts.title: Interface 2, 15-way connector
parts.text: The only header you wire to: power, the screen's SPI lines, the touch chip's I2C lines and a memory card select. A 15-way 1.25 mm pitch connector, not a 40-pin Raspberry Pi header; the lab's cable plugs into it with a white housing.

parts.label: Touch chip
parts.title: FT6336U touch controller
parts.text: Reads the touch panel and reports finger positions over I2C (TP_SDA and TP_SCL). TP_INT tells the host a touch is waiting; TP_RST resets it. It sits on the panel's own orange flex tail.

parts.label: Level translator
parts.title: Level translator
parts.text: A chip that matches the logic lines to the supply you give it, 3.3 V or 5 V. Waveshare says supply and signal voltage must be the same.

parts.label: microSD slot
parts.title: microSD card slot
parts.text: A memory card socket for pictures and files. Its select line is SD_CS on Interface 2. The 2048 demo does not use it.

parts.label: Screen flex socket
parts.title: Screen flex socket, 30 way
parts.text: The screen's flat flex cable plugs in here. Nothing to wire.
